backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing user authentication (credentials, phone/password), profile management (with blood type, allergies, emergency contacts), ML health predictions, medical file metadata storage, and integrating authorization and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the medications page center-alignment feature, listing affected files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including routing, theme management, authentication hooks, pages, components, and utilities (truncated in provided content).
frontend/DEPLOY_NOTES.md: Deployment fix documentation explaining resolution of Node.js environment variable usage in browser code and duplicate provider wiring issues, with changes to frontendEnv.ts, useInternetIdentity.ts, and main.tsx.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark themes, including default and Design B theme palettes with sidebar, chart, and semantic color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tag and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with all routes (welcome, signin, signup, home, profile, chat, report, medications, 404), wrapping with providers (Theme, DesignB, QueryClient, InternetIdentity) and DesignBAppShell layout.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialStore.ts: Local demo account management using localStorage with functions for creating accounts (fullName, phoneNumber, password), verifying credentials, enforcing phone uniqueness, and simple password hashing for demo purposes.
frontend/src/auth/demoCredentialTypes.ts: TypeScript type definitions for demo authentication including DemoAccount, VerifyCredentialsResult, and CreateAccountResult interfaces with passwordHash fields for backend sync.
frontend/src/auth/session.ts: Local session management utility for non-Internet-Identity auth flows (OTP, password, guest) with localStorage persistence, 30-day expiration, and validation logic.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Deterministic command interpreter that parses user input using pattern matching and fuzzy string matching (Levenshtein distance). Handles navigation commands, medical queries, report analysis requests, and Flutter/.dart detection with fallback responses.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Main UI panel for the health assistant featuring speech recognition, text-to-speech, transcript display with auto-scroll, and message input. Handles voice input processing, displays conversation history with confidence indicators, and formats medical content with proper structure.
frontend/src/components/assistant/assist: Manages localStorage persistence for assistant conversation transcripts with versioning (v2) and migration support. Stores messages with role, content, timestamp, and confidence level.
TypeScript type definitions for assistant messages, states, command results, confidence levels, and report analysis context.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Assist: Top-level assistant widget that orchestrates conversation flow, command interpretation, report analysis, and navigation. Manages state for transcript, report context, and integrates speech recognition with medical knowledge base and file analysis capabilities.
frontend/src/components/assistant/Custom: Empty file, likely a placeholder for custom question-answer management functionality.
frontend/src/components/assistant/custom: Empty file, likely a placeholder for custom Q&A storage functionality.
Empty file, likely a placeholder for custom Q&A type definitions.
frontend/src/components/assistant/fuzzyQ: Empty file, likely a placeholder for fuzzy matching logic for custom Q&A.
frontend/src/components/assistant/medica: Curated local medical knowledge base containing detailed information on common health topics (blood pressure, diabetes, etc.) with symptoms, causes, precautions, and emergency guidance. Provides structured medical content without external API calls.
frontend/src/components/assistant/report: Deterministic pattern-based medical report analyzer that extracts key findings, generates interpretations, identifies red flags, and suggests actions from report text using regex patterns and medical term recognition.

Provides local deterministic text extraction from report files by detecting text-based formats (txt, csv, json, etc.) and validating UTF-8 decoded content isn't binary garbage. Returns success/error results with extracted text or error codes.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useAss: React hook managing assistant conversation transcript state with localStorage persistence. Provides methods to add messages with confidence levels and clear the transcript history.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useSpe: React hook wrapping Web Speech API for voice recognition with retry logic, confidence scoring, and error handling. Supports continuous listening, interim results, and categorizes errors (network, no-speech, not-allowed, etc.).
React hook for text-to-speech using Web Speech Synthesis API. Provides speak/cancel controls with enable/disable toggle and speaking state tracking.
frontend/src/components/assistant/useTra: React hook managing auto-scroll behavior for transcript containers. Tracks user scroll position and automatically scrolls to bottom when new messages arrive if user is near bottom.
frontend/src/components/CloseButton.tsx: A reusable close button component that navigates to '/home' by default or executes a custom onClick handler, rendered as a fixed top-right icon button with an X icon.
frontend/src/designB/components/Dashboar: Reusable section header component for dashboard with title, optional caption, and action slot. Uses consistent typography and spacing.
Interactive dashboard tile component with icon, label, value, and caption. Supports multiple color accents, sizes, variants, active states, and optional close button with hover/focus animations.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBS: Simple surface container component with three variants (default, elevated, outlined) for consistent card-like UI elements.
frontend/src/designB/components/DesignBT: Typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, Caption, BodyText) providing consistent text styling across the Design B theme.
frontend/src/designB/components/ThemeSwi: Toggle switch component for switching between default and Design B themes using context.
frontend/src/designB/data/placeholders.t: Defines UserProfile interface and generates mock user data with fixed seed for consistent demo data.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBAppSh: Main app shell layout with header (logo, user name, theme switcher), content outlet, bottom tabs, assistant widget, and footer. Conditionally shows navigation and user info based on route and auth state.
frontend/src/designB/layout/DesignBBotto: Fixed bottom navigation bar with Home, Reports, and Profile tabs. Highlights active tab and uses icon+label layout.
frontend/src/designB/storage/themePrefer: localStorage utilities for persisting and loading theme preference (default or designB) with error handling.
frontend/src/designB/theme.ts: Defines a healthcare-themed design system (Design B) with color palette, fonts, spacing, and border radius constants. Exports functions to apply or remove the theme by setting a data attribute on the document root.
frontend/src/designB/themeContext.tsx: Provides React context and hooks for managing theme state ('default' or 'designB'), persisting preferences to storage, and applying the theme to the document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthSession.ts: Hook for managing local authentication session state including OTP, password-based, and guest sign-in methods, with functions to save, clear, and check session validity.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendCredentials: React hook providing queries and mutations for backend credential operations: checking if credentials exist, adding credentials, and verifying credentials via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDemoOtp.ts: Hook implementing demo OTP functionality with 6-digit code generation, verification with expiry (5 minutes), and resend cooldown (30 seconds) for phone-based authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useMedicalFiles.ts: Hook for managing medical file operations including listing files with metadata, uploading files as ExternalBlob to backend, deleting files, and downloading/viewing files with byte retrieval.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides example query hook structure and a hook to fetch the current user's profile from the backend using the authenticated actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useRedirectIfAuthenti: Hook that redirects authenticated users (with Internet Identity or valid local session) to /home, used on public pages to prevent authenticated access.
frontend/src/hooks/useRequireAuth.ts: Route guard hook that redirects unauthenticated users to /signin, checking both Internet Identity and local session state before allowing access.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDisplayName.ts: Hook that resolves user display name with priority: saved profile name, local session name/phone, guest label, or shortened Internet Identity principal.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file importing Google Fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter) and Tailwind directives. Defines comprehensive CSS custom properties for light/dark themes and a designB theme variant with color tokens for UI components.
frontend/src/lib/flaker.ts: Deterministic fake data generator using seeded PRNG (mulberry32) to create realistic user profiles including names, emails, phones, dates of birth, blood types, allergies, and emergency contacts without external dependencies.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility module exporting a `cn` function that combines clsx and tailwind-merge for conditional Tailwind CSS class merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root React component with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers, mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat page component with medical assistant interface supporting text and voice input, using assistant transcript hooks and command interpretation with status management.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Health dashboard home page displaying today's health metrics (heart rate, steps, hydration, calories) and quick action tiles for navigation to chatbot, journal, and records with active state animations.
frontend/src/pages/Medications.tsx: Medications management page displaying today's medication schedule with dosage, frequency, and tracking status, plus reminder settings for morning and evening medications.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundRedirect.tsx: 404 redirect component that automatically navigates users to /home when accessing removed or non-existent routes.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page with editable personal and medical information, validation, save functionality, and sign-out capability that clears Internet Identity and local session data.
frontend/src/pages/Report.tsx: Medical reports page that allows users to upload, view, and delete medical documents with file size formatting and success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/SignIn.tsx: Sign-in page supporting three authentication methods: Internet Identity, OTP via phone, and password-based login, with tab-based UI and guest access option.
frontend/src/pages/SignUp.tsx: Account creation page that collects full name, phone number, and password, storing credentials both locally and in backend.
frontend/src/pages/Welcome.tsx: Landing page with hero image, feature highlights, and CTAs for sign-in or guest exploration.
frontend/src/profile/profileBackendMappe: Bidirectional mapper between frontend ProfileDetails and backend UserProfile types, handling blood type enums and timestamp conversions.
frontend/src/profile/profileLocalStore.t: LocalStorage manager for user profiles keyed by phone number or guest ID, with merge logic to preserve existing data during auth initialization.
frontend/src/profile/profileTypes.ts: Defines ProfileDetails interface for frontend profile data with helper functions for empty state and data presence checks.
frontend/src/profile/profileValidation.t: Validates profile details including full name, email, phone, and emergency contact fields, returning human-readable error messages.
frontend/src/profile/useProfileDetails.t: React hook that manages profile details for both Internet Identity (backend) and local sessions (localStorage), providing query and mutation functions.
LocalStorage-based utility for managing medical file metadata; deprecated for listing purposes but kept for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/frontendEnv.ts: Reads build-time environment configuration from Vite, providing Internet Identity URL with fallback to production.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for parsing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, typography plugin, container queries, and custom animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking a medical/healthcare application with a pending feature request to center-align the medications page layout.
